Fascinating Atmosphere and Delicious Food
Apr 2019 • Friends
I had expected this place to be a bit of a tourist trap or a destination for tour groups so I'd avoided it. But, when I had a friend in town, I decided to try it out. I am so glad that I did. This was not a mass-market place like some reviews have indicated. The service was very personalized and professional. The staff was very proud of the restaurant and showed us around to see some of the other rooms and the art and handicrafts all around. The food was delicious - especially the chicken which can be a bit chewy in Vietnam (as compared to US chicken thighs and breasts). If I had one complaint about the menu it's that I find it somewhat annoying when a protein dish doesn't actually come with any sides...and those sides are a bit overpriced. That's annoying to me. But, the ambiance allows the diner to feel like he/she is dining outside in a village when really they are in cool, clean air conditioning. 

This is really an interesting place. It's quite easy to miss. But, it's absolutely worth checking out.
